mutations.name: the flake port replaces done_when without force
kills: the active-work flake port replaces the filed done_when with force, tags and reopens a done task, and appends the notes last, never closing it

mutations.name: an active-work refusal reads as an outage
mutations.find: if (error instanceof RpcError && REFUSAL_CODES.has(error.code)) throw new FixTaskRefused(`active-work refused ${error.command}: ${error.message}`);
kills: the active-work flake port names a refusal as final, so a caller does not wait it out as an outage
